definitions.gloss: getting rid of a nuisance; shaking off a burden; good riddance
definitions.explanation: The act of removing or freeing oneself from a troublesome person or situation. Composed of 厄介 (troublesome, burdensome) + 払い (clearing away). Functions as a suru-verb.

examples.japanese: {厄介払|やっかいばら}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I managed to get rid of the nuisance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧な⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{厄介払|やっかいばら}い⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We got rid of the troublesome customer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厄介払|やっかいばら}いだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ではないか→ではないか：30627_dehanaika⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{疑|うたが}っている→疑う：01889_utagau⟧。
examples.english: I suspect the transfer was actually a way to get rid of me.

notes:
USAGE:
{厄介払|やっかいばら}い implies removing a troublesome presence, often a person. It can be used as a suru-verb ({厄介払|やっかいばら}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) or with ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厄介払|やっかいばら}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to get rid of a nuisance)
- {厄介払|やっかいばら}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (to manage to get rid of a nuisance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{追|お}い{払|はら}う→追い払う：06347_oiharau⟧ means to drive away or chase off, focusing on the physical act. {厄介払|やっかいばら}い emphasizes relief from a burden rather than the act of removal itself.
